title: Nav2 default-parameter changelog (demo)
description: Every change to the default parameter files in nav2_bringup, with old → new values.

items.title: Velocity/acceleration limits changed: velocity_smoother.max_accel[0] 2.5→3.0, velocity_smoother.max_accel[2] 3.2→3.5, velocity_smoother.max_decel[0] -2.5→-3.0 and 1 more.
